title: 家庭生活
description: 與家人互動及家庭相關話題

sentences.en: My parents, who have been married for over thirty years now, still make it a point to have dinner together every single evening.
sentences.zh: 我的父母結婚已經超過三十年了，他們仍然堅持每天晚上一起吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Growing up with three siblings taught me the importance of sharing, compromise, and learning how to resolve conflicts peacefully.
sentences.zh: 和三個兄弟姐妹一起長大教會了我分享、妥協以及學會和平解決衝突的重要性。

sentences.en: Ever since my daughter started elementary school, our weekday mornings have become a chaotic rush of getting everyone ready and out the door on time.
sentences.zh: 自從我女兒開始上小學後，我們工作日的早晨就變成了一場混亂的趕忙，要讓每個人準時出門。

sentences.en: What I cherish most about our family gatherings is the way everyone puts aside their differences and just enjoys being together for a while.
sentences.zh: 我最珍惜我們家庭聚會的是每個人都放下分歧，只是享受在一起的時光。

sentences.en: My grandmother, who just turned eighty-five last month, still insists on cooking for the entire family whenever we visit her on holidays.
sentences.zh: 我奶奶上個月剛滿八十五歲，每當我們節日去看她時，她仍然堅持為全家人做飯。

sentences.en: Although my brother and I used to fight constantly as children, we've grown much closer as adults and now talk on the phone almost every day.
sentences.zh: 雖然我和我哥哥小時候經常吵架，但長大後我們變得親近多了，現在幾乎每天都通電話。

sentences.en: One of the traditions that our family has maintained for generations is gathering at my grandparents' house for a big meal during the Lunar New Year.
sentences.zh: 我們家族世代相傳的傳統之一是農曆新年期間到祖父母家聚在一起吃大餐。

sentences.en: Having two young children at home means that my wife and I rarely get a quiet evening to ourselves, but we wouldn't trade it for anything.
sentences.zh: 家裡有兩個小孩意味著我和太太很少有安靜的夜晚獨處，但我們不會拿它換任何東西。

sentences.en: My father, a retired teacher who now spends most of his time gardening, has always been the one I turn to for advice when I'm facing a tough decision.
sentences.zh: 我父親是一位退休教師，現在大部分時間都在園藝，當我面臨困難決定時，他一直是我尋求建議的對象。

sentences.en: The thing I miss most about living with my family is coming home to the smell of my mother's cooking after a long day at school.
sentences.zh: 我最想念和家人住在一起的是在學校漫長的一天後回到家聞到媽媽做菜的味道。

sentences.en: Since both my wife and I work full-time, we've had to come up with a system for dividing household chores and childcare responsibilities fairly.
sentences.zh: 因為我和太太都是全職工作，我們必須想出一個公平分配家務和育兒責任的制度。

sentences.en: Watching my children grow up and develop their own personalities has been one of the most rewarding experiences of my entire life.
sentences.zh: 看著我的孩子長大並發展出自己的個性是我一生中最有意義的經歷之一。

sentences.en: Every Sunday afternoon, my family and I go for a walk along the river, which has become our favorite way to spend quality time together.
sentences.zh: 每個星期天下午，我和家人沿著河邊散步，這已經成為我們最喜歡的一起度過優質時光的方式。

sentences.en: My mother-in-law, who lives just a few blocks away from us, is always happy to help out with the kids whenever we need a babysitter.
sentences.zh: 我的岳母住在離我們只有幾條街的地方，每當我們需要有人照顧孩子時，她總是很樂意幫忙。

sentences.en: The biggest challenge of raising teenagers, as far as I'm concerned, is finding the right balance between giving them freedom and keeping them safe.
sentences.zh: 就我而言，養育青少年最大的挑戰是在給他們自由和確保他們安全之間找到正確的平衡。

sentences.en: I'm incredibly grateful that my parents always encouraged me to pursue my passions, even when my choices didn't align with their expectations.
sentences.zh: 我非常感激我的父母總是鼓勵我追求自己的熱情，即使我的選擇不符合他們的期望。

sentences.en: Now that my kids are old enough to help around the house, we've assigned each of them specific chores that they're responsible for completing each week.
sentences.zh: 既然我的孩子已經大到可以幫忙做家事了，我們給每個人分配了特定的家務，他們每週要負責完成。

sentences.en: What surprised me most about becoming a parent was how much patience it requires, especially during those first few months when you're barely getting any sleep.
sentences.zh: 成為父母最讓我驚訝的是需要多大的耐心，尤其是在最初幾個月幾乎得不到任何睡眠的時候。

sentences.en: My sister, who recently moved back home after living abroad for several years, has been helping our aging parents with their daily needs.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐最近在國外住了幾年後搬回家，一直在幫助我們年邁的父母處理日常需求。

sentences.en: Despite living in different cities, my family makes an effort to video call each other at least once a week so that we can stay connected.
sentences.zh: 儘管住在不同的城市，我的家人努力每週至少視訊通話一次，這樣我們可以保持聯繫。

sentences.en: The dinner table has always been the place where our family discusses everything from school projects to weekend plans to life's bigger questions.
sentences.zh: 餐桌一直是我們家人討論一切的地方，從學校作業到週末計畫再到人生更大的問題。

sentences.en: I think the reason our family is so close is that my parents always prioritized open communication and made sure everyone felt heard and valued.
sentences.zh: 我認為我們家人這麼親密的原因是我父母總是優先考慮開放的溝通，確保每個人都感到被傾聽和重視。

sentences.en: When my youngest son started kindergarten last September, I was surprised by how emotional I felt watching him walk into the classroom for the first time.
sentences.zh: 去年九月我最小的兒子開始上幼稒園時，我驚訝於看著他第一次走進教室時自己有多麼感動。

sentences.en: My husband and I have agreed that no matter how tired we are, we'll always make time to read a bedtime story to our children before they fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 我和丈夫達成共識，不管我們多累，我們總是會在孩子睡著前撥出時間念睡前故事給他們聽。

sentences.en: As the oldest child in my family, I always felt a sense of responsibility to set a good example for my younger brothers and sisters.
sentences.zh: 作為家中的長子，我總是感到有責任為弟弟妹妹樹立好榜樣。

sentences.en: The holiday season is my favorite time of year because it's when our entire extended family comes together under one roof to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 假期是我一年中最喜歡的時候，因為那是我們整個大家庭聚在一個屋簷下一起慶祝的時候。

sentences.en: My parents taught me from a very young age that family isn't just about blood relations — it's about the people who show up for you when you need them.
sentences.zh: 我的父母從我很小的時候就教我，家人不只是血緣關係——而是那些在你需要時出現的人。

sentences.en: Balancing work responsibilities with being present for my children's school events is something I constantly struggle with but refuse to give up on.
sentences.zh: 平衡工作責任和出席孩子的學校活動是我一直在掙扎但絕不放棄的事情。

sentences.en: I still remember how nervous I was when I first introduced my partner to my family, but thankfully everyone got along wonderfully from the very beginning.
sentences.zh: 我還記得我第一次把伴侶介紹給家人時有多緊張，但幸好從一開始大家就相處得非常好。

sentences.en: What I hope to pass down to my children more than anything else is the value of kindness, empathy, and treating every person with respect.
sentences.zh: 我最希望傳給孩子的是善良、同理心以及尊重每一個人的價值觀。
